message.reasoning:
Assess. Key technical error: "geostationary orbit at an altitude of 600 km" — geostationary is ~35,786 km; 600 km is LEO. Also geostationary can't give high-resolution imaging of reef. Preliminary progress is thin (tutorials, reading). Mission concept good with references. Plan has Gantt chart, sources? Information sources: only four URLs cited in concept; planned sources not explicitly listed beyond that — partial R5. Software: STK selected — R3 met. R2: plan relates to launch/orbits — yes, though flawed.

Marks: C1: 8 (accomplished, clear, referenced). C2: 6 (adequate-good; Gantt with detail, contingency not addressed) — 6. C3: 4-5; minor work: tutorials, reading, flawed orbit statement → 4. C4: 7-8; well structured, consistent, references cited → 8.
